citations.claim: Microsoft reported operating income growth of 15%, or 16% in constant currency, and a 43% operating margin that was relatively unchanged year over year.
citations.source_text: Excluding the impact of the change in accounting estimate, gross margin percentage increased slightly even with the impact from purchase accounting adjustments, integration and transaction related cost from the Activision acquisition.
